card.name: Verbs and linking words before an object
card.fires_on: Verbs or small linking words (with, the, keep, found) that come just before a direct object noun, in general explanatory web text. Often the object is about to be an egg, young, child, or a thing.

modes.label: Linking word before egg or sperm
modes.description: With or the right before a reproductive object in text on contraception or fertility.
modes.example: making it impossible for them to combine<< with>> an egg.

modes.label: Verb awaiting its object
modes.description: A verb such as lost, keep, found, kill, or raises, where the object noun comes next.
modes.example: has often<< lost>> sight of what is best for children,

modes.label: Play or move with/the
modes.description: With or the after a verb like play, move, or raises, before a thing or animal.
modes.example: But will he play<< with>> it?

card.writes: It nudges the model toward the object noun after the verb, and away from plural person nouns like patients or customers.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before the thing a verb acts on, like the word before 'an egg' or 'the young'.
